**3. The likely file manifest and its tiers.** For every file this story would plausibly touch, give its tier and owner from `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` and `.claude/rules/protectedFiles.md` — NEVER from `.claude/registry/*.md`, whose Tier column is a derived heuristic and is wrong in places. Flag any Tier 1 file. Give import blast radius for anything shared.

**4. The nearest existing pattern.** This codebase has strong precedent. What is the closest thing already built — the ui-kits atoms, the PDP static product info work (SFCC-89, PR #57/#64), the footer (PR #59)? What structure would a new swatch component follow: directory layout, `.css.ts` recipe, story, test, `Zimm*` recipe naming, registration in `theme/components/index.ts`?

**5. Branch state.** Is there a local or remote `feature/SFCC-91*` branch? How far ahead/behind `develop` is it? Do NOT check it out — inspect with `git log`, `git diff --stat origin/develop...<branch>`.

Cite `file:line` throughout. Distinguish VERIFIED from inferred. Where a documented rule and the code disagree, say so loudly. End with a section headed exactly `What I could not verify`.

## Summary

**Fonts are self-hosted and served on every tier.** `overrides/app/static/fonts/` holds two
Futura Round faces — Regular 400 and Medium 500 — declared by
`overrides/app/theme/fontFace.tsx` and mounted in both `_app-config/index.tsx` and

revision of this section claimed there was. `ZimmFontFace` mounts unconditionally inside
`_app-config`'s `ChakraProvider`, and `pwa-kit-dev`'s `staticFolderCopyPlugin` copies
`overrides/app/static` in both the client and SSR webpack configs — so the `.woff2` are
published with every bundle and shoppers on every storefront render Futura Round.

`foundation/fonts.ts` already lists `'Futura Round'` first in both stacks, so the `@font-face`
declaration is the only thing that makes it resolve — no component, recipe or token changes.

design-parity review against Figma.

    77	            Object.keys(variationParams).every(
    78	                (key) => variationValues[key] === variationParams[key]
    79	            )
    80	        )
    81	        .some(({orderable}) => orderable)
    82	}

    85	 * Use a decorated version of a product variation attributes. This version
    86	 * will have the following additions: which variation attribute is selected,
    87	 * each value will have a product url, the swatch image if there is one, and
    88	 * an updated orderable flag.
    89	 *
    90	 * @param {Object} product
    91	 * @param {boolean} isProductPartOfSet
    92	 * @param {boolean} isProductPartOfBundle
    93	 * @param {Object} controlledVariationValues - Optional controlled variation values (skips URL reading)
    94	 * @param {Function} onVariationChange - Optional callback for controlled mode (attributeId, value) => void
    95	 * @returns {Array} a decorated variation attributes list.
    96	 *
    97	 */
    98	export const useVariationAttributes = (
    99	    product = {},
   100	    isProductPartOfSet = false,
   101	    isProductPartOfBundle = false,
   102	    controlledVariationValues = null,
   103	    onVariationChange = null
   104	) => {
   105	    const {variationAttributes = []} = product
   106	    const location = useLocation()
   107	    const variationParams = useVariationParams(
   108	        product,
   109	        isProductPartOfSet,
   110	        isProductPartOfBundle,
   111	        controlledVariationValues
   112	    )
   113	    const existingParams = usePDPSearchParams(product.id)
   114	    const isBundleChildVariant = isProductPartOfBundle && product?.type?.variant
   115	
   116	    // In the product bundle edit modal on the cart page, the variant ID of each bundle child is used as a key
   117	    // for query parameters, so when a new variant is selected, a new query parameter is added since variants
   118	    // have different IDs. The old one is not overwritten with existing logic so we remove it here
   119	    if (isBundleChildVariant && !controlledVariationValues) {
   120	        const [allParams] = existingParams

   122	            if (variantId !== product.id && allParams.get(variantId)) {
   123	                allParams.delete(variantId)
   124	            }
   125	        })
   126	    }
   127	
   128	    // In controlled mode, we don't depend on location.search
   129	    const isControlled = controlledVariationValues !== null
   130	    const memoKey = isControlled ? product : [location.search, product]
   131	
   132	    return useMemo(
   133	        () =>
   134	            variationAttributes.map((variationAttribute) => ({
   135	                ...variationAttribute,
   136	                selectedValue: {
   137	                    name: variationAttribute.values.find(
   138	                        ({value}) => value === variationParams?.[variationAttribute.id]
   139	                    )?.name,
   140	                    value: variationParams?.[variationAttribute.id]
   141	                },
   142	                values: variationAttribute.values.map((value) => {
   143	                    const params = {
   144	                        ...variationParams,
   145	                        [variationAttribute.id]: value.value
   146	                    }
   147	
   148	                    return {
   149	                        ...value,
   150	                        image: getVariantValueSwatch(product, value),
   151	                        // In controlled mode, don't provide href (use callback instead)
   152	                        href: isControlled
   153	                            ? null
   154	                            : buildVariantValueHref({
   155	                                  pathname: location.pathname,
   156	                                  existingParams,
   157	                                  newParams: params,
   158	                                  productId: product.id,
   159	                                  isProductPartOfSet,
   160	                                  isProductPartOfBundle
   161	                              }),
   162	                        orderable: isVariantValueOrderable(product, params)
   163	                    }
   164	                })
   165	            })),
   166	        Array.isArray(memoKey) ? memoKey : [memoKey]
   167	    )
   168	}
